defect_observations: 055 body and annex are restricted to finite relational vocabularies without constants (body 44-75), whereas Kolaitis's Defs 2.1, 3.1, 7.4 and Thm 7.9 allow constant symbols; the handbook results are the constant-free special case.

Annex line 286: '...in \cref{def:p03-w03-p03-038-positions}; whose domain is all of A and whose range is all of B by the last conjunct; so it is an isomorphism' is ungrammatical (semicolon before a relative clause).

Connectivity corollary (body 499-518) treats undirected cycles C_{2m} vs C_m + C_m; Kolaitis's Example 7.7 concerns directed cycles; the body notes this at 523-524 but the directed case is not reconstructed.
